name: Ryuusenji Renren
source:
Renren enrolled in Kimisaki High when she was a first year, but she was born in China. She is very talented in kenpo. Burning with flames of rivalry towards the Judo Club, Renren often challenges [url=/c98550]Hikaru[/url] to matches and tries to steal [url=/c98253]Isami[/url] away. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
